mapper.insert: INSERT INTO external_benchmark_values ( company_id, source_code, dataset_code, metric_code, base_year, industry_code, industry_name, original_value, original_unit, normalized_value, normalized_unit, source_updated_at, raw_payload, synced_at, sync_run_id ) VALUES ( #{companyId}, #{sourceCode}, #{datasetCode}, #{metricCode}, #{baseYear}, #{industryCode}, #{industryName}, #{originalValue}, #{originalUnit}, #{normalizedValue}, #{normalizedUnit}, #{sourceUpdatedAt}, CAST(#{rawPayload} AS JSONB), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{syncRunId} ) ON CONFLICT (company_id, source_code, metric_code, base_year, industry_code) DO UPDATE SET dataset_code = EXCLUDED.dataset_code, industry_name = EXCLUDED.industry_name, original_value = EXCLUDED.original_value, original_unit = EXCLUDED.original_unit, normalized_value = EXCLUDED.normalized_value, normalized_unit = EXCLUDED.normalized_unit, source_updated_at = EXCLUDED.source_updated_at, raw_payload = EXCLUDED.raw_payload, synced_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, sync_run_id = EXCLUDED.sync_run_id
mapper.select: SELECT id, company_id, base_year, industry_code, status, triggered_by, started_at, completed_at, error_message FROM external_benchmark_sync_runs WHERE company_id = #{companyId} ORDER BY started_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT DISTINCT metric.reporting_year FROM esg_metric_data metric JOIN esg_indicators indicator ON indicator.id = metric.indicator_id WHERE metric.company_id = #{companyId} AND metric.status = 'APPROVED' AND indicator.indicator_code = 'IND_E_ELEC' AND metric.shipment_amount_million_krw > 0 ORDER BY metric.reporting_year DESC

WITH month_periods AS ( SELECT month_no, make_date(#{year}, month_no, 1) AS period_start, (make_date(#{year}, month_no, 1) + INTERVAL '1 month - 1 day')::DATE AS period_end FROM generate_series(1, 12) AS month_no ), eligible_facilities AS ( SELECT period.month_no, COUNT(facility.id)::INT AS expected_count FROM month_periods period LEFT JOIN company_facilities facility ON facility.company_id = #{companyId} AND facility.operation_start_date <= period.period_end AND ( facility.operation_end_date IS NULL OR facility.operation_end_date >= period.period_start ) GROUP BY period.month_no ), matched_facilities AS ( SELECT electricity.period_value AS month_no, COUNT(DISTINCT electricity.facility_id)::INT AS matched_count FROM esg_metric_data electricity JOIN esg_indicators electricity_indicator ON electricity_indicator.id = electricity.indicator_id AND electricity_indicator.indicator_code = 'IND_E_ELEC' JOIN esg_metric_data scope2 ON scope2.company_id = electricity.company_id AND scope2.facility_id = electricity.facility_id AND scope2.reporting_year = electricity.reporting_year AND scope2.period_type = electricity.period_type AND scope2.period_value = electricity.period_value AND scope2.status = 'APPROVED' JOIN esg_indicators scope_indicator ON scope_indicator.id = scope2.indicator_id AND scope_indicator.indicator_code = 'IND_E_SCOPE2' JOIN company_facilities facility ON facility.id = electricity.facility_id JOIN month_periods period ON period.month_no = electricity.period_value AND facility.operation_start_date <= period.period_end AND ( facility.operation_end_date IS NULL OR facility.operation_end_date >= period.period_start ) WHERE electricity.company_id = #{companyId} AND electricity.reporting_year = #{year} AND electricity.period_type = 'MONTHLY' AND electricity.status = 'APPROVED' AND electricity.shipment_amount_million_krw > 0 GROUP BY electricity.period_value ), month_status AS ( SELECT period.month_no, eligible.expected_count, COALESCE(matched.matched_count, 0) AS matched_count, eligible.expected_count > 0 AND COALESCE(matched.matched_count, 0) = eligible.expected_count AS is_complete FROM month_periods period JOIN eligible_facilities eligible ON eligible.month_no = period.month_no LEFT JOIN matched_facilities matched ON matched.month_no = period.month_no ) SELECT MAX(status.month_no) FROM month_status status WHERE status.expected_count > 0 AND status.is_complete AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM month_status previous WHERE previous.month_no <= status.month_no AND previous.expected_count > 0 AND NOT previous.is_complete )

WITH electricity AS ( SELECT metric.facility_id, metric.period_value, metric.numerical_value, metric.shipment_amount_million_krw FROM esg_metric_data metric JOIN esg_indicators indicator ON indicator.id = metric.indicator_id JOIN company_facilities facility ON facility.id = metric.facility_id WHERE metric.company_id = #{companyId} AND metric.reporting_year = #{year} AND metric.period_type = 'MONTHLY' AND metric.period_value BETWEEN 1 AND #{throughMonth} AND metric.status = 'APPROVED' AND indicator.indicator_code = 'IND_E_ELEC' AND metric.shipment_amount_million_krw > 0 AND facility.operation_start_date <= (make_date(#{year}, metric.period_value, 1) + INTERVAL '1 month - 1 day')::DATE AND ( facility.operation_end_date IS NULL OR facility.operation_end_date >= make_date(#{year}, metric.period_value, 1) ) ), scope2 AS ( SELECT metric.facility_id, metric.period_value, metric.numerical_value FROM esg_metric_data metric JOIN esg_indicators indicator ON indicator.id = metric.indicator_id WHERE metric.company_id = #{companyId} AND metric.reporting_year = #{year} AND metric.period_type = 'MONTHLY' AND metric.period_value BETWEEN 1 AND #{throughMonth} AND metric.status = 'APPROVED' AND indicator.indicator_code = 'IND_E_SCOPE2' ) SELECT COALESCE(SUM(electricity.numerical_value) / 1000.0, 0) AS electricity_mwh, COALESCE(SUM(electricity.shipment_amount_million_krw) / 100.0, 0) AS shipment_hundred_million_krw, COALESCE(SUM(scope2.numerical_value), 0) AS scope2_tco2eq, COUNT(*)::INT AS matched_facility_months FROM electricity JOIN scope2 ON scope2.facility_id = electricity.facility_id AND scope2.period_value = electricity.period_value
